answer: A bond of 30% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in wharf, and anchor reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 80 aliases, and each one needs its own funded atlas account. The per-identity price is 120 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
